myths.claim: ITI ke baad seedha B.Tech ho sakta hai
myths.explanation: Official admission guidelines state that ITI certificate holders cannot enter B.Tech / B.E. directly. The standard pathway is ITI -> Diploma (Direct Second Year) -> B.Tech (Lateral Entry).
myths.quote: Holders of National Trade Certificates (ITI) without a recognised Polytechnic Diploma shall not be admitted directly to Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering programmes.

myths.claim: Diploma gives 100% guaranteed job and salary
myths.explanation: Official sources do not provide employment guarantees or fixed salary assurances. Placement assistance depends on candidate performance, market conditions, and institute placement cells.
myths.quote: Participation in campus interviews is subject to student eligibility, academic performance and employer criteria. No guarantee of placement or minimum salary is asserted by the Board.

myths.claim: Any ITI trade qualifies for any engineering diploma branch
myths.explanation: Direct Second Year admission requires that the completed two-year ITI trade is formally mapped to the diploma branch as per Table 3.2.
myths.quote: A candidate who has passed the Class X examination and holds a Two-Year Craft Certificate in a Mapped Trade shall be eligible for Direct Second Year admission to a Diploma in a Mapped Branch
